decks.notes: The main strategy of this deck is to quickly cycle through cards and control the board until the player can cast Living End to bring back all creatures from both players' graveyards, essentially wiping the board and giving the player a significant advantage. The deck utilizes a combination of cycling creatures, disruption spells, and cascade effects to set up the Living End combo. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures while maintaining control over the game through counter spells and card draw.

This deck focuses on quickly lowering your own life total to trigger the powerful abilities of Death's Shadow and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek to disrupt your opponent's hand, along with efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Terminate, you can control the game while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion allows for additional mana ramp and flexibility. Mishra's Bauble helps to fuel Delirium for Drown in the Loch and Unholy Heat, making this deck a formidable force in Modern Aggro matchups.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using cards like Arboreal Grazer, Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, and Wrenn and Six to accelerate into powerful spells. Teferi, Time Raveler provides disruption while cards like Expressive Iteration and Prismatic Ending offer card advantage and removal. The centerpiece of the deck is the Scapeshift combo, where Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and lands are sacrificed to deal lethal damage to the opponent. Control elements like Supreme Verdict and Boseiju, Who Endures help to protect the combo and control the game.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using a mix of removal spells, counterspells, and versatile creatures. The deck aims to establish and maintain board control while disrupting the opponent's game plan. With the help of cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, the deck can outvalue the opponent and generate incremental advantages. Additionally, the inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for a consistent source of card advantage and resilience against aggressive strategies. Overall, the deck seeks to dictate the pace of the game and grind out incremental advantages to secure victory.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize low-cost spells and efficient creatures to put pressure on the opponent quickly. By combining burn spells like Lightning Bolt with disruptive cards like Counterspell and Archmage's Charm, the deck aims to control the game while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent. Using cards like Mishra's Bauble to filter draws and Expressive Iteration to generate card advantage, the deck can quickly outpace opponents and close out games before they have a chance to stabilize.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six. It also utilizes versatile creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ice-Fang Coatl to apply pressure while maintaining board control. The deck includes a mix of different colors to access a wide range of powerful spells and threats. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as a companion to provide additional value and flexibility. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents through careful resource management and strategic decision-making.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying threats and disrupting the opponent's game plan with a combination of hand disruption spells like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize, along with removal spells such as Fatal Push and Lightning Bolt. The deck also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and Wrenn and Six to generate value and control the game. Additionally, the deck includes efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Tarmogoyf to pressure the opponent and close out games quickly. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive strategy while also enabling powerful land synergies with cards like Urza's Saga.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble the Colossus Hammer combo as quickly as possible, by using cards like Puresteel Paladin, Stoneforge Mystic, and Sigarda's Aid to equip the hammer for free. The deck also utilizes cards like Esper Sentinel and Spell Pierce for disruption and protection, while including support cards like Giver of Runes and Shadowspear for added utility. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a powerful, combo-driven strategy that can deal massive amounts of damage in a short amount of time.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly and efficiently, using cards like Arboreal Grazer, Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, and Amulet of Vigor to accelerate into big threats like Primeval Titan. The key concept revolves around utilizing the Amulet Titan combo to generate massive amounts of mana and overwhelmed opponents with powerful creature plays. By efficiently utilizing land plays and untapping creatures, the deck aims to quickly assemble its key pieces and overwhelm the opponent with big creatures and powerful land interactions, ultimately aiming to win the game quickly through explosive plays.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively control the board with a mix of powerful creatures, efficient removal spells, and disruptive counter magic. By utilizing efficient threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Murktide Regent, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, the deck aims to apply pressure early on while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Lightning Bolt, Counterspell, and Unholy Heat. The deck also features card advantage and selection with cards like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble, as well as having the flexibility to adapt to various game states with options like Archmage's Charm and Spell Pierce.

This deck focuses on using powerful creatures like Death's Shadow, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It also relies on disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Drown in the Loch to control the opponent's resources. Mishra's Bauble and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer help to generate card advantage and maintain tempo. The deck aims to pressure the opponent early and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize, using a combination of aggressive creatures and targeted disruption.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent using low-cost aggressive creatures and burn spells, taking advantage of the Trigger ability of Eidolon of the Great Revel to punish the opponent for casting spells. The deck aims to close out the game as quickly as possible by consistently applying pressure and finishing off the opponent with direct damage spells like Lava Spike and Lightning Bolt. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy with fast lands like Arid Mesa and Inspiring Vantage.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces needed to equip Colossus Hammer onto a creature and deal massive amounts of damage in a short amount of time. This involves using cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Puresteel Paladin to search for and equip the Hammer, while also utilizing cards like Memnite and Ornithopter as cheap creatures to attach the equipment to. The deck also includes protection spells and utility lands like Urza's Saga to help maintain control and consistency in executing the combo.

This deck focuses on assembling the combo of Colossus Hammer with Puresteel Paladin and Sigarda's Aid to equip the hammer for free and swing for lethal damage early in the game. The deck also utilizes synergy with Stoneforge Mystic and Ingenious Smith to tutor for key pieces and maximize card advantage. The Reality Chip acts as a backup win condition if the primary combo is disrupted, while cards like Esper Sentinel and Spell Pierce provide disruption and protection. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive game plan while ensuring consistency in finding the combo pieces.

The main purpose of this deck is to maintain control over the game by using a combination of powerful creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing the synergies between Elementals and control cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and control the board. Additionally, the inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion adds extra value and flexibility to the deck. Its key concept revolves around generating incremental advantage through powerful Elemental creatures and disruption spells to dominate the battlefield and emerge victorious.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful control spells and versatile creatures to manipulate the board state and outvalue the opponent. By incorporating Yorion as a companion, the deck can generate incremental advantage over time with flicker effects like Ephemerate. With a strong mana base and a mix of removal, card draw, and ramp spells, the deck aims to control the game until it can deploy its powerful threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation and utilize synergy between various creatures like Ice-Fang Coatl and Risen Reef to overwhelm the opponent.
